metadata.question: Does aerosol concentration (aerosol optical depth) in western Brazil decrease in August from 2002 to 2018?

data.raw_code: The user asks: "Does aerosol concentration (aerosol optical depth) in western Brazil decrease in August from 2002 to 2018?" We need to: 1. Define western Brazil region (probably a polygon around the western part of Brazil) 2. Get AOD data for August 2002 and August 2018 3. Compare the AOD values between the two time periods 4. Check if there's a decrease (2018 < 2002) For AOD data, we can use: - MODIS Terra/Aqua Aerosol Optical Depth products (MOD04_L2, MYD04_L2) - Or MERRA-2 reanalysis data - Or Sentinel-5P TROPOMI (but only from 2018 onwards, so not for 2002) Best option: MODIS Terra (MOD04_L2) which has data from 2000 onwards. We can use the 'Corrected_Optical_Depth_Land' band or 'Aerosol_Optical_Depth_Land_And_Ocean' band. We need to: 1. Define geometry for western Brazil 2. Get August 2002 data (Aug 1-31, 2002) and August 2018 data (Aug 1-31, 2018) 3. Calculate mean AOD for each period 4. Compare if 2018 mean < 2002 mean We need to handle: - Cloud masking? AOD products already provide quality flags. We should filter by quality. - Check for empty collections - Check for valid pixels after masking - Validate results (AOD should be between 0-1 typically, though can be higher during fires) Potential issues: - MODIS Terra might have gaps, we might need to use MODIS Aqua as fallback - August is dry season in western Brazil, so clouds might be less of an issue Let me structure: 1. Define polygon for western Brazil 2. Get MODIS Terra AOD data for Aug 2002 and Aug 2018 3. Filter by quality (use QA flag) 4. Calculate mean AOD for each period 5. Compare and output answer We need to output: - Number of images for each period - Mean AOD values - Pixel counts to check validity - Final answer tag ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions // Western Brazil polygon (approx bounds: longitude -75 to -50, latitude -20 to 0) const geometry = ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [[-75, -20], [-75, 0], [-50, 0], [-50, -20]] ]); // August 2002 const startDate2002 = '2002-08-01'; const endDate2002 = '2002-08-31'; // August 2018 const startDate2018 = '2018-08-01'; const endDate2018 = '2018-08-31'; // Function to get MODIS Terra AOD data function getMODIS_AOD(startDate, endDate, collectionName) { let collection = ee.ImageCollection(collectionName) .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filterBounds(geometry); // Apply quality filter - only keep high quality retrievals (QA flag = 3 for best quality) // For MOD04_L2, 'Quality_Assurance_Land' band has quality flags // We'll mask pixels where QA != 3 (not the best quality) collection = collection.map(function(image) { const aod = image.select('Corrected_Optical_Depth_Land'); const qa = image.select('Quality_Assurance_Land'); // Mask where QA is not 3 (binary 11 = good quality) const mask = qa.eq(3); return aod.updateMask(mask).copyProperties(image, ['system:time_start']); }); return collection; } // Try MODIS Terra first (MOD04_L2) let col2002 = getMODIS_AOD(startDate2002, endDate2002, 'MODIS/006/MOD04_L2'); let col2018 = getMODIS_AOD(startDate2018, endDate2018, 'MODIS/006/MOD04_L2'); // Check collection sizes const size2002 = col2002.size().getInfo(); const size2018 = col2018.size().getInfo(); console.log(`2002 August Images (Terra): ${size2002}`); console.log(`2018 August Images (Terra): ${size2018}`); // If empty, try MODIS Aqua (MYD04_L2) as fallback if (size2002 === 0) { console.log("Trying MODIS Aqua for 2002..."); col2002 = getMODIS_AOD(startDate2002, endDate2002, 'MODIS/006/MYD04_L2'); const newSize2002 = col2002.size().getInfo(); console.log(`2002 August Images (Aqua): ${newSize2002}`); if (newSize2002 === 0) { console.log("C1"); return; } } if (size2018 === 0) { console.log("Trying MODIS Aqua for 2018..."); col2018 = getMODIS_AOD(startDate2018, endDate2018, 'MODIS/006/MYD04_L2'); const newSize2018 = col2018.size().getInfo(); console.log(`2018 August Images (Aqua): ${newSize2018}`); if (newSize2018 === 0) { console.log("C1"); return; } } // Create mean composite for each period const mean2002 = col2002.mean(); const mean2018 = col2018.mean(); // Calculate mean AOD and pixel count for each period const stats2002 = mean2002.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: geometry, scale: 10000, // MODIS AOD is at 10km resolution maxPixels: 1e9, bestEffort: true }).getInfo(); const stats2018 = mean2018.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: geometry, scale: 10000, maxPixels: 1e9, bestEffort: true }).getInfo(); const meanAOD2002 = stats2002['Corrected_Optical_Depth_Land']; const count2002 = stats2002['Corrected_Optical_Depth_Land_count']; const meanAOD2018 = stats2018['Corrected_Optical_Depth_Land']; const count2018 = stats2018['Corrected_Optical_Depth_Land_count']; console.log(`2002 Mean AOD: ${meanAOD2002 ? meanAOD2002.toFixed(3) : 'null'}, Valid Pixels: ${count2002}`); console.log(`2018 Mean AOD: ${meanAOD2018 ? meanAOD2018.toFixed(3) : 'null'}, Valid Pixels: ${count2018}`); // Check for no valid pixels if (count2002 === 0 || count2018 === 0) { console.log("C2"); return; } // Check for calculation failure if (meanAOD2002 === null || meanAOD2018 === null || isNaN(meanAOD2002) || isNaN(meanAOD2018) || meanAOD2002 < 0 || meanAOD2018 < 0) { console.log("C3"); return; } // Check if AOD decreased (2018 < 2002) if (meanAOD2018 < meanAOD2002) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
